summary: A tonewheel organ with nine drawbars: 91 shared sine wheels switched onto the drawbar busses by every key held, a single-trigger percussion (2nd or 3rd harmonic), key click, a scanner vibrato and chorus (V1 - V3, C1 - C3), a tube-style overdrive and a rotary speaker with horn and drum rotors that speed up and slow down with their own inertia. Every key can sound at once (the cost does not grow with the number of keys). Use it for gospel, jazz, blues, rock and reggae organ, church sounds, flute stops and organ stabs.
use_for: Drawbar tonewheel organ with percussion, key click, vibrato and chorus, overdrive and a rotary speaker: gospel, jazz, blues and rock organ, church sounds, flutes and stabs.

parameters.description: Drawbar 16': the sub-octave, one octave below the played note. Steps 0 - 8, about 3 dB a step
parameters.how: Sets the level of the 16 foot drawbar from 0 (off) to 8 (full), 3 dB a step.
parameters.sound: It adds a deep, round weight an octave below the notes; pulled out alone it sounds like a pipe organ's bass.

parameters.description: Drawbar 5 1/3': the fifth above the 16', a fifth above the played note
parameters.how: Sets the level of the 5 1/3 foot drawbar from 0 to 8, 3 dB a step.
parameters.sound: It gives a hollow, reedy fifth under the note; with the 16' and 8' it makes the classic jazz registration.

parameters.description: Drawbar 8': the played note itself
parameters.how: Sets the level of the 8 foot drawbar from 0 to 8, 3 dB a step.
parameters.sound: It is the fundamental: a pure, round flute-like tone and the body of every registration.

parameters.description: Drawbar 4': the octave above the played note
parameters.how: Sets the level of the 4 foot drawbar from 0 to 8, 3 dB a step.
parameters.sound: It adds a light octave and a flute-like brightness over the fundamental.

parameters.description: Drawbar 2 2/3': the twelfth, an octave and a fifth above the played note
parameters.how: Sets the level of the 2 2/3 foot drawbar from 0 to 8, 3 dB a step.
parameters.sound: It adds a hollow, nasal twelfth that makes a tone sound reedy or like a clarinet.

parameters.description: Drawbar 2': two octaves above the played note
parameters.how: Sets the level of the 2 foot drawbar from 0 to 8, 3 dB a step.
parameters.sound: It adds a bright, pipe-like edge.

parameters.description: Drawbar 1 3/5': the major third, two octaves and a third above the played note
parameters.how: Sets the level of the 1 3/5 foot drawbar from 0 to 8, 3 dB a step.
parameters.sound: It adds a sharp, reedy third that gives a trumpet or oboe edge.

parameters.description: Drawbar 1 1/3': the fifth, two octaves and a fifth above the played note
parameters.how: Sets the level of the 1 1/3 foot drawbar from 0 to 8, 3 dB a step.
parameters.sound: It adds a thin, glassy brightness.

parameters.description: Drawbar 1': three octaves above the played note (it is muted while Percussion is on)
parameters.how: Sets the level of the 1 foot drawbar from 0 to 8, 3 dB a step; Percussion silences it, as on the original instrument.
parameters.sound: It adds a shimmering, whistling top that makes the sound cut through a band.

parameters.name: Percussion
parameters.description: Percussion: a decaying 2nd or 3rd harmonic added to the held keys; it fires only when no other key is held (single trigger) and mutes the 1' drawbar
parameters.how: Switches the percussion on; it plays on the first note of a phrase only, and the 1 foot drawbar goes quiet while it is on.
parameters.sound: It adds a bell- or marimba-like pluck at the start of a phrase; played legato, only the first note gets it.

parameters.name: Perc harmonic
parameters.description: Which harmonic the percussion plays: 2nd (the 4' wheel, an octave up) or 3rd (the 2 2/3' wheel, an octave and a fifth up)
parameters.how: Chooses the percussion's pitch: the 2nd harmonic (an octave above the note) or the 3rd (a twelfth above).
parameters.sound: The 2nd is round and woody; the 3rd is brighter and more bell-like.

parameters.name: Perc decay
parameters.description: Percussion decay: fast 0.2 s or slow 0.7 s to fall by 20 dB
parameters.how: Chooses how quickly the percussion fades: fast (0.2 s to fall 20 dB) or slow (0.7 s).
parameters.sound: Fast is a short tick that sits in the attack; slow rings on like a struck bar.

parameters.name: Perc level
parameters.description: Percussion level: soft is 8 dB below normal
parameters.how: Chooses the percussion's loudness: soft (8 dB down) or normal.
parameters.sound: Soft tucks the pluck under the drawbars; normal makes it stand out.

parameters.name: Key click
parameters.description: Level of the click each key makes as it closes and opens; 0 is no click
parameters.how: Sets the loudness of the contact click at note on and note off, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: Off the notes start smoothly like a pipe organ; more adds the percussive chiff of a tonewheel organ's contacts.

parameters.name: Leakage
parameters.description: Crosstalk: every wheel leaks a trace of its signal into the unpressed keys (up to -56 dB each)
parameters.how: Sets how much of every tonewheel leaks into the other keys, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: A little makes the tone slightly alive and fuzzy under the notes, as a real tonewheel organ is; none is a perfectly clean generator.

parameters.name: Vibrato
parameters.description: Scanner vibrato or chorus on or off
parameters.how: Switches the scanner vibrato or chorus on.
parameters.sound: It adds a gentle wobble in pitch (V) or a swirling doubling (C) to everything you play.

parameters.name: Vibrato type
parameters.description: V1 - V3: vibrato of 6, 12 and 24 cents; C1 - C3: the same sweep mixed with the dry sound as chorus
parameters.how: Chooses the scanner setting: V1, V2, V3 are vibrato from light to deep; C1, C2, C3 are chorus from light to deep.
parameters.sound: V settings wobble the pitch like a singer; C settings thicken the sound with a slow, shimmering doubling.

parameters.name: Drive
parameters.description: Tube-style overdrive before the rotary speaker, with level compensation (a -14 dBFS sine keeps its peak level at any setting); 0 is clean
parameters.how: Sets how hard the sound is pushed into a tube-style overdrive, from 0 (clean) to 100 %.
parameters.sound: More drive adds warm, singing harmonics and a growl on the low drawbars; the loudness stays about the same.

parameters.name: Rotary
parameters.description: Rotary speaker on or off (off is a plain stereo pair of the dry sound)
parameters.how: Switches the rotary speaker on; off gives the dry organ in both channels.
parameters.sound: On, the sound swirls around the room; off it is direct and static.

parameters.name: Speed
parameters.description: The rotors' target speed: Slow (chorale), Fast (tremolo) or Stop (they brake to rest)
parameters.how: Chooses the speed the horn and drum turn towards: Slow, Fast or Stop; they speed up and slow down with their own inertia.
parameters.sound: Fast is a fast tremolo and swirl, Slow a gentle chorus, Stop a fixed room-like sound; the change itself is the sound of the speaker spinning up or down.

parameters.name: Horn slow
parameters.description: The horn's slow speed in revolutions per second (0.8 Hz is 48 rpm)
parameters.how: Sets how fast the high-frequency horn turns at Slow, from 0.2 to 3 Hz.
parameters.sound: It sets the pace of the gentle chorale swirl in the highs.

parameters.name: Horn fast
parameters.description: The horn's fast speed in revolutions per second (6.7 Hz is 400 rpm)
parameters.how: Sets how fast the horn turns at Fast, from 2 to 14 Hz.
parameters.sound: It sets the speed of the fast tremolo in the highs.

parameters.name: Drum slow
parameters.description: The drum's slow speed in revolutions per second (0.67 Hz is 40 rpm)
parameters.how: Sets how fast the low-frequency drum turns at Slow, from 0.2 to 3 Hz.
parameters.sound: It sets the pace of the slow pulse in the lows and mids.

parameters.name: Drum fast
parameters.description: The drum's fast speed in revolutions per second (5.7 Hz is 342 rpm)
parameters.how: Sets how fast the drum turns at Fast, from 2 to 12 Hz.
parameters.sound: It sets the speed of the fast pulse in the lows and mids.

parameters.name: Horn accel
parameters.description: The horn's inertia: the time constant of its speed change (it covers 63 % of the change in this time; 90 % of the fast speed from Slow takes about 2.2 times as long)
parameters.how: Sets how quickly the horn changes speed, as a time constant from 0.05 to 8 s.
parameters.sound: Short times make the swirl jump to the new speed; long times give a slow, heavy run-up.

parameters.name: Drum accel
parameters.description: The drum's inertia: the time constant of its speed change (the drum is heavier, so its default is five times the horn's)
parameters.how: Sets how quickly the drum changes speed, as a time constant from 0.1 to 20 s.
parameters.sound: The drum lags behind the horn when you switch speed, which is much of the speaker's charm.

parameters.name: Depth
parameters.description: How deeply the rotors change the loudness as they turn past the microphones
parameters.how: Sets the depth of the loudness swirl, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: More depth gives a stronger tremolo; less sounds more like a chorus.

parameters.name: Doppler
parameters.description: The pitch change of the moving sources, in percent of the real geometry (100 % is about 36 cents at the horn's fast speed)
parameters.how: Sets the strength of the Doppler pitch wobble, from 0 to 200 % of the real size.
parameters.sound: It adds the typical shimmering detune of a rotating speaker; zero leaves only the loudness swirl.

parameters.name: Mic spread
parameters.description: The angle between the two virtual microphones (0 % is the same place, 100 % is opposite sides)
parameters.how: Sets how far apart the two virtual microphones stand, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: More spread makes the swirl travel between the left and right speakers; none is mono.

parameters.name: Horn/drum
parameters.description: Balance between the horn (highs, above 800 Hz) and the drum (lows): -100 % is all drum, +100 % is 6 dB more horn and 6 dB less drum
parameters.how: Sets the balance between the horn and the drum, from drum to horn.
parameters.sound: Towards the horn the swirl is brighter and more fluttery; towards the drum it is darker and rounder.

parameters.name: Volume
parameters.description: Output level
parameters.how: Sets the final level in dB, from off to +12.
parameters.sound: It makes the organ louder or quieter without changing its character.

parameters.name: Expression
parameters.description: A swell pedal before the overdrive and the speaker: the gain is the square of the setting, so 50 % is -12 dB
parameters.how: Sets the swell pedal from 0 to 100 %, before the overdrive and the rotary speaker.
parameters.sound: Rolling it back softens the whole organ and cleans up the overdrive, as pulling back on a swell pedal does.
